title: Slippery When Wet Rentals
specs: Delivery included to multiple lakes near Omaha
Pre-ride safety briefing and equipment walkthrough
Meticulously maintained Sea-Doo jet ski fleet
Renter must be 21+ with valid government photo ID and credit card used to book
Operators must be 14+ in Nebraska (boater education card required if born after Dec 31, 1985)
Operators must be 12+ in Iowa (boater education card required if 12-17)
Passengers must be 7+ and wear a properly-fitted U.S. Coast Guard-approved PFD at all times
No alcohol or drugs before or during the rental
includes: Delivery to the ramp and launch
Coast Guard–approved life jackets for every rider
gap: Maximum weight per rider not stated
blurb: Guests rent jet skis delivered to their chosen lake near Omaha, including Fremont Lakes, Lake Manawa, Branched Oak, and Levi Carter. Rentals include delivery, launch, a full tank of premium fuel, Coast Guard-approved life jackets, and a pre-ride safety briefing. The operator handles setup, safety, and pickup, providing a fully managed lake day experience.
extraNote: Limited Damage Waiver fee of $200 caps out-of-pocket damage responsibility · No alcohol on the ski during rental; impaired operation voids rental and waiver · Return ski at agreed time and location; late returns billed hourly · At the lake launch ramp where the jet skis are delivered · April 15 – October 15
